_comment: Things found at sea: each waits on the map (a "find" kind, drawn by scripts/finds.gd) until you sail to it. find_near: sea or reef.

wreck_on_reef.title: A wreck on the reef
wreck_on_reef.text: The bones of a big ship lie on the reef, her stern still above the breakers. {nation_adj} by the carving on her transom. Whatever she carried is under four fathoms of clear water.

choices.result: They come up blue-lipped and grinning, again and again: coin, plate, a chest of silver bars.
choices.fail_result: A surge throws a diver against the coral. They bring the body up, and nothing else.

choices.text: Strip her for timber and cordage
choices.result: A day's hard work with axes and saws. Your carpenter is delighted.

choices.text: Leave her: a wreck on a reef means more reef
choices.result: You stand off and give her a wide berth.

battle_wreckage.title: Wreckage
battle_wreckage.text: Charred spars, a stove-in boat, casks and worse on the swell. A ship died here not long ago. Clinging to a hatch cover, {survivor} raises an arm.

choices.text: Haul {survivor} aboard and offer a berth
choices.result: {survivor} coughs up half the sea and swears to serve the ship that stopped.
Salt pork, a few casks of rum, some of it still good.

choices.text: Leave the dead to the sea
choices.result: The men watch the hatch cover drift astern in silence.

dispatch_bag.title: Dispatches
dispatch_bag.text: A canvas dispatch bag, weighted with shot so it would sink if the ship was taken. It didn't. Inside, under the seal of the {nation_adj} admiralty: orders for their cruisers.

choices.result: Courses, stations and dates. For a month you'll know where their cruisers are.

choices.text: Hand it in, seal unbroken, at the next {nation_adj} port
choices.result: An honest captain is rarer than you'd think. Word will get round.

turtles.title: Turtles
turtles.text: Green turtles basking on the surface, dozens of them. Every sailor in these waters knows what that means: fresh meat that stays alive in the hold for weeks.

choices.text: Lower the boats and turn them
choices.result: Thirty turtles on their backs in the hold. Turtle soup tonight.
choices.fail_result: Most of them dive before the boats get close.

sea_chest.title: A sea chest
sea_chest.text: An iron-bound sea chest floats past, riding high: something light inside, or something sealed tight. Somebody's whole life, perhaps.

choices.text: Fish it out and break it open
choices.result: Coins wrapped in oilcloth, and a waterstained chart with an anchorage marked that isn't on yours.
